what: [operating-model] .claude/skills/system-report/SKILL.md (a live, catalog-listed skill) instructs a session to 'invoke /system-review and follow .claude/skills/system-review/SKILL.md verbatim'. .claude/skills/system-review/ does not exist on disk -- it is one of the ten skills CLAUDE.md's 2026-09-21 reset says were retired and archived to docs/archive/2026-09-21-operating-reset/skills/system-review/. .claude/settings.json's own SessionStart hook text says plainly '(The /system-review roll-up is RETIRED and archived; do not invoke it.)'. Invoking /system-report today points a session at a file that isn't there.

due_when.clears_when: system-report/SKILL.md either redirects to the three live review skills (health-review, performance-review, ml-review) per CLAUDE.md's 'the three reviews stay separate' section, or is itself retired/archived to match system-review.
